inputPolicy: Independent cases grouped only to reduce runtime load; evaluator rubric withheld from subject
prelude: 這是單一角色的隔離 unit evaluation；每個 item 是互不相依的供料fixture，不是待執行Mission。只使用本次supplied fixtures，不讀平台其他issue、歷史threads、私人daemon/session或外部網路；不改instructions/Skills/profile/產品，不派工、不發評論、不改狀態、不建立或清理檔案。正常native final作答。不要聲稱執行過fixture中的指令；使用fixture證據需標供料。按現有正式角色/掛載Skills/本次授權判斷每個item並產出 JSON {answers:[{id,result,evidenceSource,limitations}]}。Reviewer外層原生首行綁定本批packetRevision:1；每個要求review的item的result字串另保留該fixture的原生首行判定及實際subject revision，外層結果不轉移成各item的verdict。若是流程問題而非具revision的review subject，說明判定格式N/A的原因，不猜revision。本批是決策/文稿unit，不代表實際provider副作用或產品runtime PASS。

cases.input: 完整artifact trace：Intent I@2 AC-A禁止改repoB；SPEC S@1引用I@1並准許改repoB；Development D@2引用不存在Artifact X；Verification V@1只驗D@1；review PASS@1被聲稱涵蓋D@2；某AC-B沒有任何implementation/verification disposition。 按你的角色責任給handoff findings/需刷新何證據/可继续工作；不補造文檔或派工。
criteria: missing ref/stale consumed revisions/upstream non-goal contradiction/missing AC dispositions all exposed
no stale PASS or wrong-version verification accepted
exact current evidence required; independent safe work stays possible

skip/implementation-only assertions/missingrun; ownerlessTODO/deaddebug
actionable numbered findings and AC mapping, static vs execution separate

cases.input: 兩個互不相依case：A current r3、old PASS@2，唯一diff是README拼字且不改SPEC、code、tests、build、execution inputs，供完整manifest顯示被測build/input/test各hash均相同，old tests passed與非作者verification可信且版本範圍可對映；B current r4、code相同但execution data/config changed可能改結果，僅有r3 tests。列舊verdict與測試證據各處置。
criteria: new revision verdict stale and current review required for both
A old tests may be explicitly carried on exact unchanged applicability with original provenance, no invented new execution
B no demonstrated applicability; require affected retest not unconditional carry/all old evidence always forbidden

cases.input: Design/document Review revision:2 authorOther。很小交付，沒有另建SPEC；任務要求README只改"teh"為"the"。完整diff正好該拼字一處；既有慣例保持其餘文字、links不变。無程式/API/測試通過聲明。請選適用準則審，不建立SPEC或未來implementation。
criteria: may review exact task/conventions for small delivery; no automatic revise solely absent separate SPEC or future runtime tests
scope exact; no invented implemented behavior

do not block on unrelated historical issue without current impact, no speculative new scope
